scope: Reconstruction/association experiment, not a constitutive physics milestone
training: Matched full-state continuation from50000 for2000 actual optimizer updates, no LR reset/topology changes
static_image_audit: Independent blue-core LK/FB tracks; static multi-view triangulation with alternating-observation fit/check; actual trained camera convention; no camera fitting
static_gate: At least12 tracks with>=8 observations,>=2deg ray baseline, held-observation median<=1.5px andp90<=3px, all positive depth; support in early/mid/late training time thirds
static_binding: Complete native1600 color-adjoint contributions over120 training views; blue purity>=.98 of whole-image mass, duck leakage<=.005, >=3 blue-support observations and opacity>=.05
static_selector_revision: Core-only semantic selection failed37.29% mean coverage before any training. Revision2 uses full independent blue semantic region for selection; eroded core remains the unchanged evaluation domain. All purity/coverage thresholds retained. Duck-bank rows are explicitly excluded from static rows.
static_coverage_gate: Selected rows cover mean>=.5 and every time-third mean>=.3 of blue-core alpha mass; no full-object identity claim
static_anchors: Independent LK-triangulated points; bind only already-blue rows with source projection<=3px and multi-observation median<=2px, RMS<=3px; at least8 anchors. Robust3D tolerance.02 scene units. No novel-view dense pseudo GT
dynamic_binding: Fresh full-state native support; independent image-component continuity and raw frozen flow; same local bank only within its own clip; unknown/occluded associations terminate
local_shape: Same-clip same-component fixed edges, log length ratio tolerance[.5,2], rigid-motion invariant; no F/stress/material law or cross-object KNN
evaluation: Full-state original-camera validation30+test50; all200 times at3 fixed cameras plus moving control; per-view shape proxies, separately blue/duck appearance; selected native RGB/alpha, videos; training-term diagnostics
success: Report reconstruction quality and fixed-view outcomes separately; no success from proxy improvement alone, disappearing objects, or static-only improvement; no new-view PSNR without independent GT
protection: Original PIDG/C1/T1/O1 and all previous outputs/caches unchanged; no learned material segmentation, per-Gaussian free stiffness/force, or synthetic novel-view GT
